## Core Architecture
- Multi-head attention with causal masking to maintain autoregressive properties
- Rotary positional embeddings for enhanced sequence understanding and better long-range dependencies
- Layer normalization and residual connections for stable training depth

## Performance Optimizations
- Key-value caching during inference to avoid recomputing previous tokens
- Flash attention implementation for memory-efficient attention computation
- Mixed precision training with bfloat16 for faster computation and reduced memory footprint

## Production Considerations
- Gradient clipping to ensure training stability
- Learning rate scheduling with warmup phases for optimal convergence
- Robust tokenizer handling for variable-length sequences and proper padding strategies
